run_create_imagenet_data_files: run the script to extract ImageNet-1K or Places205 dataset image paths and labels into numpy files
run_get_all_classes: run get_all_classes to scan a directory and return a mapping of class folder names to integer indices
run_get_images_labels_info: run get_images_labels_info to collect image paths, class labels, and optional JSON output for a train or val split
run_main_with_json: run the main function with --generate_json 1 to also produce per-partition target JSON files alongside numpy arrays
review_get_images_labels_info: review get_images_labels_info to understand how it walks class subdirectories and builds image path and label lists
